title: Conformal Calibration Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2609.10737v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conformal prediction converts point predictions into set-valued predictions with coverage guarantees under exchangeability between calibration and deployment data. We study conformal calibration transfer, where this requirement fails because labeled calibration is available only in a source space, while prediction sets are needed in a target space linked to the source through unlabeled paired observations (e.g., paired modalities or sensor changes). We propose Transported Conformal Calibration (TCC): we transport labeled source calibration into the target space using the paired data, and then correct residual post-transport mismatch using only unlabeled target inputs. We instantiate this correction with two complementary methods: TCC-KS, which uses a label-free uncertainty surrogate to detect mismatch and adjust calibration conservatively, and weighted-TCC, which reweights transported calibration toward the target domain for improved eff

translated_abstract: 保形预测在校准数据与部署数据满足可交换性假设的条件下，将点预测转换为具有覆盖保证的集合预测。我们研究保形校准迁移问题，此时该假设不再成立，因为有标签的校准数据仅存在于源空间中，而需要在目标空间中生成预测集合，该目标空间通过无标签的配对观测与源空间相关联（例如配对的模态或传感器更换场景）。我们提出传输保形校准：利用配对数据将有标签的源空间校准传输至目标空间，随后仅使用无标签的目标输入来修正传输后的残余失配。我们以两种互补的方法来实现该修正：TCC-KS，它使用一种无标签的不确定性代理来检测失配并进行保守的校准调整；以及加权TCC，它通过向目标域方向对传输后的校准重新加权，以改进……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出传输保形校准（TCC）框架，在仅有源空间有标签校准数据的情形下，借助无标签配对观测将校准迁移至目标空间，并仅用无标签目标数据修正残余失配，从而在目标域实现具有覆盖保证的保形预测。
en_tdlr: Proposes Transported Conformal Calibration (TCC), which transfers labeled source calibration to the target space using unlabeled paired observations and corrects residual post-transport mismatch with only unlabeled target inputs, enabling conformal prediction with coverage guarantees when labeled calibration exists only in a source domain.
